description:
Restore a file to its content before its newest recorded change.
                        Every write_file and edit_block call keeps the previous content of the file
                        (last 20 changes per file, under ~/.remotepilot/snapshots). Calling this
                        again goes one change further back. A file that did not exist before the
                        change is removed. Files over 5 MiB are not kept and cannot be undone.

                        This command can be referenced as "DC: ..." or "use RemotePilot to ..." in your instructions.
name: undo_last_change
